tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud kyi las byang ngag bsgrigs su khol bur byas pa nye bar mkho ba bzhugs so//

na mo ba la banta kṛṣṇa ye: skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas: hūm̐ */ chos rnams snang med mkha' ltar stong : chos rnams de bzhin spros dang bral: ma rtogs sems can kun la khyab: longs sku thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: rgyu yig rig pa hūm̐ du 'bar: sprul skus 'gro ba ma lus 'dren: 'og phyogs su e 'phros nam mkha' gru gsum mthing nag yangs pa: de dbus yaṃ las rlung gzhu lta bu 'degs raṃ las me gru gsum rab tu 'bar: baṃ las chu dkyil zlum po laṃ las gser gyi sa gru kha bzhi gzhi'o de'i steng du: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab thod pa'i mkhar: kha ni so can sog kha gyen du 'bar de'i steng: bhrūṃ smug nag thod pa'i gzhal yas khang : dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbus su e: gru gsum mthing nag de'i phyi thod phreng mu khyud zlum po gnyis brtsegs kyi phyi: gru bzhi chad dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo mu khyud phyi ma'i nang du/ rtsibs bco brgyad pa steng so can: rin chen sna lnga'i gzhal yas khang de'ang khyams la sgo bzhi sgo khyud dang ldan pa'i: phyi rol du sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang de'i phyi rol du me ri smug nag 'bar bas bskor: gzhal yas de'ang lha chen brgyad kyi ka gdan byas pa klu chen brgyad kyi ka ba la: gza' chen brgyad kyi ka gzhu byas pa mchog chen gyi gdung ma byas pa la: mchog phran gyi dral ma dang zhing chen gyi thog g.yogs bkab pa: zhing chung dang thod pa'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa kun tu 'phyang pa las:

rnag 'dzag cing khrag dang chu ser gyi zham chu 'bab pa: phyi nang rab tu gsal zhing nyi zla gza' skar gyis brgyan pa: de'i dbus su lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad dang ru tra'i steng du: ma dang a dang paṃ gsum las padma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi: steng du rang sems mthing nag yi ge hūm̐ du bab: phaṭa kyis 'od zer rab spros don gnyis byas 'dus pas rdo rjer gyur: de las 'od 'phros 'dus las yongs su gyur pa bdag nyid che mchog sku: dpal chen stobs ldan nag po chen por gyur: oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: shrī hai ru ka hūm̐ āḥ dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad de: dbus zhal gsum mthing g.yas gsum dkar: g.yon gsum dmar la zhabs brgyad po: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dregs pa brdzis: dbu skra kham nag thod skam nang : rigs lngas dbu brgyan sde brgyad kyi: mgo bcad thod pa 'di phreng bas se ral kha byas pa: sku stod la zhing lpags dang sku smad la: chu srin gyi pags pa'i sham thabs 'chang ba: klu brgyad dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis: sku brgyan phyag g.yas dgu rdo rje dang : phyag g.yon dgu bhan dha dmar gyis bkang ba 'dzin pa: gar sgeg pa dpa' ba snying rje ngo mtshar dgu 'jigs rgod gshe rngam snying rje ngo mtshar nyams ldan spyi bor khyung sor spu gri'i 'dab gshog gdengs pa mchus sbrul za ba rdo rje'i sder mos ro nye 'dzin pa : mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po g.yas pa zangs kyi rdo rje g.yon bhandha bsnams pa snying ga ru: rdo rje gzhon nu'i mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon phur bu gdengs pa sked par ni: phyag rdor mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub gdengs pa gsang gnas gshin rje mthing nag g.yas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad g.yon thod dbyug rta mgrin rdo rje gzhon nu phyag rdor gshin rje rnams dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa:

thugs kar hūm̐ la snying pos bskor: hūm̐ de las bhyo chad pa las g.yon nas 'khyud pa'i yum: ( lan tsa ) 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo ni: dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: dang po'i phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa dang : phyag bar pa gnyis tri shūl dang zhing dbyug la: phyag tha ma gnyis bum pa bdud rtsi zhing lpags g.yob pa: sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa zhabs bzhir ldan: stobs ldan nag po'i thugs srog hūm̐ de las e gcig chad pas: gru gsum gyi mdun zur du bab e de las ni: spyi gzer 'jig rten pa gza' bdud rā hu la dud kha dbu dgu pa: steng du bya rog tong sgra 'byin: ro stod mi la ro smad sbrul: mgo lus med pa mig gis gang : phyag g.yas chu srin rgyal mtshan 'phyar: g.yon pas rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin: gzhan yang gru g.yas su tri las 'chi bdag srog len nag: g.yas pa ri rab dang g.yon rgya gram 'dzin pa: stag sham zhing lpags rlon pa gyon: mu las gnod byed khrag 'thung nag: g.yas g.yon mi snying dang thod khrag thogs pa: sku smad la gzig sham dang sku stod la mi lpags gos su gyon: gru g.yon yi ge tri gsum las: sku yi mon pa ljang nag ni: 'khor lo g.yas la be con g.yon: gsung gi mon pa dmar nag ni: g.yas g.yon be con rgyu zhags thogs: thugs kyi mon pa mthing nag ni: g.yas pa ral gri g.yon be con: kun kyang smad la stag sham dang stod la zhing lpags gyon: stobs ldan gtso bo zhal lhor phyogs pa yi: mdun rtsibs nas bzung ste g.yas skor du: ya las 'chi bdag nag po ni: thod pa g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud g.yag bcibs: ma las ma mo skye 'gro srog bdag nag:

thod pa g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud rta bcibs: a las lha chen ma hā de wa dkar: shel gri g.yas la ba dan g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te mi rgod zhon: tha las kā lā yaksha nag: kha ṭwāṃ g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te dur phag zhon: du las bdud po me'i kha rlangs nag: khram shing g.yas la rgyu zhags g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud rta bcibs: du las bdud mo khrag 'dzag ma nag: dar nag g.yas la khram shing g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud bya zhon: ra las raksha srin po glog phreng nag: ral gri g.yas la thod khrag g.yon pa: zhing lpags gsol te 'brug la zhon: ra las srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig dmar: gri gug g.yas la mi mgo g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te me la zhon: ra las gza' bdud sku mdog nag: dgra sta g.yas la khro bo g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te glog la zhon: kṣa las gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po ljang : bshan gri g.yas la ru mtshon g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag zhon: kṣa las gnod sbyin mo sha za ral can ljang : dar nag g.yas la ru mtshon g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag zhon: tsa las rgyal po le byin har legs dkar: shel gri g.yas la dar dkar g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te sprel nag zhon: pa las dmu rje btsan pa nag: dar nag g.yas la zhags pa g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag zhon: tsa las btsan rgod yam shud dmar po dmar: mdung dmar g.yas la btsan gri g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te btsan rta rgyug: tri las dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dmar: dar dkar g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te ra skyes zhon: dri las 'gong po khu le lag dgu dmar: rnga yab g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te ce spyang zhon: tri las dam sri rkang lag ring po nag: ber ka g.yas la mi mgo g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bong bu zhon:

phu las klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po sngo: bum pa g.yas la rus sbal g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te chu srin zhon: kun kyang ti ra ro gdan la: sgrub pa'i tshe dregs pa rnams zhal nang du lta bar bskyed: las sbyor gyi dus dregs pa rnams zhal phyir lta bar bskyed do: gang gi dus kyang de rnams kyi snying khar rang rang gi rnam shes kyi: yig 'bru re la rang ming gis bskor ba las: gzir 'phrog gcod sogs skabs kyis bsgyur pa'i sham bu dang bcas pa: dregs pa de dag re re la'ang 'khor: pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud gsum kyis: bsdus pa'i lha 'dre bye ba sa ya dang : stong phrag brgyad cus rab tu bskor ba'i: de rnams snying gar rang dang rnam shes kyi: yig 'bru re la rang ming gis bskor ba: de dag thams cad bdag gi bka' nyan cing : ci bgyi'i pho nyar gsal bar gyur: ces bsgom/ sha chen gyi spos dang bcas spyan drangs bzhugs gsol sogs ni: hūm̐ */ thabs shes stong gsal chos sku'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs ldan yab yum gshegs su gsol: gru gsum e yi dkyil 'khor steng du bzhugs su gsol: sde brgyad dmag dpon gza' bdud gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag srog len yab yum gshegs su gsol: las mkhan mon pa rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams nas: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan dregs pa gshegs su gsol: ti ra ro yi gdan la bzhugs su gsol: badzra sarba duṣṭa e dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phrin las zil gnon drag pos dregs pa 'dul: thabs shes gnyis med stobs ldan yab yum la: lus ngag yid gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: las kyi dbang gis dregs pa'i stobs rnyed cing: dam tshig dbang gis bka' yi bstan pa srung*/ sde dpon dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dzaḥho: e ma hoḥ mdzes pa'i gzhal yas bhandha ka pā la yi nang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ma lus sbyar: sha khrag dmar dang snying snas rab tu brgyan: chang phud a mṛ ta dang raktas bran: snod dang bcud ldan pa'i mthun pa'i mchod pa 'bul: lha mchog stobs ldan yab yum mnyes gyur cig: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig: badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta la kha kha khā hi swā hā: de nas sman raka byin brlabs gtor mar bsgron la: drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ke ta ke ta rā hu la i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: tri mu i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: tri tri tri i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ya ma i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma ma ru lu i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: de wa i maṃ bha liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: tirti ka i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: du phrag i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: duntiṃ i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: raksha i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: rakmo i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: yaksha i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: yakmo i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: rā tsa i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: mun mun i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: badzra sā dhu i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: haṃ shaṃ i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ru tri i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

sa nā ga i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: sarba sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ a mṛ ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes sngags rnams nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul: phan gnod kyi las gang byed kyi phrin las bcol dregs pa rnams bkrag mdangs mthu dang drag rtsal dang ldan nas gang bcol phan gnod las byed par bsam: de nas rang bzhin bstod cing sgrub pa ni: dza bhyoḥ chos dbyings mi 'gyur pho brang nas: gru gsum mthing nag bskal pa'i me dpung klong: mi 'gyur mi shigs stobs ldan nag po'i sku: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad de: g.yas zhal gsum dkar skye med chos kyi sku: g.yon zhal gsum dmar thugs rje chags pa'i sku: dbus zhal gsum mthing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: zhabs brgyad dregs pa'i snying khar rab tu gzir: dbu skra kham nag thod pa rigs lngas brgyan: sde brgyad mgo bcad thod pa'i se ral kha: sku stod zhing lpags sku smad chu srin sham thabs brgyan: klu brgyad sku brgyan dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: phyag g.yas dgu nas gser gyi rdo rje 'phen: snang srid dregs pa ma lus gzir bar byed: g.yon dgu bhan dmar dregs pa'i snying khrag 'thung: zhabs brgyad dregs pa'i snying khar rab gzir dbang du sdud: stobs ldan nag po'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa dbang sdud zil gyis gnon par mdzod: bhyoḥ yum gcig 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo ni: zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog dmar la gshe: g.yas g.yon dang pos gri gug bhandha bsnams: bar pas tri shūl zhing gi zhags pa 'phen: tha ma bdud rtsi zhing gi g.yab mo rdeb: zhabs bzhis dregs pa kun gzir dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: snang srid ma mo zil gnon dbang du sdud: dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bhyoḥ nam mkha' g.yu 'od 'bar ba'i lding khang na: gza' bdud chen po ma rungs pa: khyab mjug chen po kun tu rgyu:

'jigs byed chen po sprul pa'i sku: pha ni srin la ma ni klu: klu srin tshogs pa'i mthu bo che: ro stod mi la ro smad sbrul: dbu dgu sde brgyad rokti'i sprul pa 'gyed: mgo lus med pa mig gis khengs: sku mdog rab 'jigs dud kha'o: phyag g.yas chu srin zhags pa bsnams : g.yon pas rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la ya: lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs pa: nub kyi phyogs nas lam du rgyug: zla ba'i rjes gcod shar du rgyug: nyi ma'i rjes gcod nub tu rgyug: nyin mo rgyu zhing mtshan mo 'joms: phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu rgyug: bar snang khams la rgyug tsa na: 'jig rten khams kun 'khrugs shing sreg: lo nyes 'khrug pa rims nad gtong : nyi ma zla ba khyur mid byed: rgya mtsho'i gting na gnas tsa na: klu rnams 'khrug cing thog ser gtong: bhyoḥ 'jigs byed chen po ma rungs pa: ming brgya po la mtshan stong po: dus tshod tshes grangs kun gyi bdag: lha srin sde brgyad nang dbyen byed: 'byung ba lnga yi dug chen po: khyod la ming gi rnam pa dgu: nub kyi phyogs nas skyod pa'i tshe: kiṃ kaṃ 'bar ba tsa ra ka: ma mo'i dal yams dgra la bhyo: shar lho'i mtshams nas skyod pa'i tshe: drang srong chen po rā hu la: dgra lha'i rgyal mo'i thog ser bhyo: byang gi mtshams nas skyod pa'i tshe: bdud po rokti 'bar ba'i sku: bdud nad hur thuṃ dgra la bhyo: lho nub mtshams nas skyod pa'i tshe: srin po raksha bi tri ta: srin po'i gri thabs dgra la bhyo: shar gyi phyogs nas skyod pa'i tshe: dmu bdud chen po hā li ka/ dmu nad dmu rdo dgra la bhyo: nub byang phyogs nas skyod pa'i tshe: klu btsan du ba mjug ring po: gzer nad gzer shu dgra la bhyo: lho yi phyogs nas skyod pa'i tshe: khyab 'jug chen po zhes bya ba: gshin rje'i dmag dpung dgra la bhyo: byang shar phyogs nas skyod pa'i tshe:

bi nā ya ka zhes bya ba: bgegs kyi dmag dpung dgra la bhyo: ri rab khong gseng nas skyod tshe: skar chen 'bar ba 'od po che: su 'phrad za zhing gtong mi byed: khyod ni khro chen pho nya yin: khams gsum mthu chen 'gran zla med: bskal pa grangs med sngon rol du: sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa srung: 'jig rten phung ba'i drag shul can: phyag rdor gshin rje'i bya khyung rgyal: rta mgrin rokti rdo rje 'chang : spyan sngar khas blangs dam yang bcas: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : rnal 'byor grogs byed dam nyams sgrol: ston pa'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i las 'di myur du gyis: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: gza' bdud chen po'i dus la bab: ma hā de wa'i= 'chi bdag gshin rje'i= klu bdud nag po'i= dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i= sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snang srid dregs pa las la 'gyed pa dang : gzir zhing sreg mnan phrin las 'grub par mdzod: nam du yang yang bskul ba rab tu gces: sde brgyad yongs kyi bya ma rta: las rnams kun gyi nang byan yin: zhes pas so// srog len yab yum dang mon pa rnam gsum bskul ba ni: bhyoḥ gsod byed dregs pa'i sde dpon ni: rgya dang bal po'i sa mtshams na: 'chi bdag srog len nag po bhyo: gsod byed khrag 'thung nag po bhyo: las mkhan mon pa rnam gsum bhyo: sku yi mon pa ljang nag la: gsung gi mon pa dmar nag po: thugs kyi mon pa mthing nag ste: las kyi gshin rje rnam pa gsum: tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag bhyo: dgra bgegs tshe srog dus mtha' stungs: gdug byed mtshon cha'i rang gshed phob: 'byung bzhi'i bcud bsdus srog dbugs chod: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes pa/ ya bag sha yi las 'di ni: ha la nag po tse ma re: de nas bco brgyad rim par bskul: dza bhyo ya: ya las sku bskyed gshin rje 'chi bdag nag po khyod: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag:

thod pa g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud g.yag bcibs: bstan pa srungs shig gshin rje'i tshogs: 'chi bdag nag po'i btsun mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: thod pa g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud rta bcibs: bstan pa srungs shig ma mo'i tshogs: a las sku bskyed lha chen ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: shel gri g.yas la ba dan g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te mi rgod zhon: bstan pa srungs shig lha yi tshogs: tha las sku bskyed mu stegs ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: kha ṭwāṃ g.yas la gri gug g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te dur phag zhon: bstan pa srungs shig mu stegs tshogs: du las sku bskyed bdud po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: khram shing g.yas la rgyu zhags g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud rta bcibs: bstan pa srungs shig bdud po'i tshogs: de dang gnyis med bdud mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: dar nag g.yas la khram shing g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bdud bya zhon: bstan pa srungs shig bdud mo'i tshogs: ra las sku bskyed srin po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: ral gri g.yas la thod khrag g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te 'brug la zhon: bstan pa srungs shig srin po'i tshogs: de dang gnyis med srin mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: gri gug g.yas la mi mgo g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te me la zhon: bstan pa srungs shig srin mo'i tshogs: ra las sku bskyed gza' bdud ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog smug: dgra sta g.yas la khram baṃ g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te glog la zhon: bstan pa srungs shig rā hu la: kṣa las sku bskyed gnod sbyin ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang : bshan gri g.yas la ru mtshon g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag zhon: bstan pa srungs shig gnod sbyin tshogs: kṣa las sku bskyed gnod sbyin mo:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang : dar nag g.yas la ru mtshon g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag zhon: bstan pa srungs shig gnod sbyin tshogs: tsa las sku bskyed rgyal po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: shel gri g.yas la dar dkar g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te sprel nag zhon: bstan pa srungs shig rgyal po'i tshogs: pa las sku bskyed dmu bdud ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: dar nag g.yas la zhags pa g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te rta nag bcibs: bstan pa srungs shig dmu yi tshogs: tsa las sku bskyed btsan rgod ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: mdung dmar g.yas la btsan gri g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te btsan rta rgyug: bstan pa srungs shig btsan gyi tshogs: tri las sku bskyed dge bsnyen ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: dar dkar g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te ra skyes bcibs: bstan pa srungs shig the'u rang tshogs: tri las sku bskyed 'gong po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser: rnga g.yab g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te ce spyang zhon: bstan pa srungs shig 'gong po'i tshogs: tri las sku bskyed dam sri ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag: ber ka g.yas la mi mgo g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te bong bu zhon: bstan pa srungs shig dam sri'i tshogs: phu las sku bskyed klu rgyal ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo: bum pa g.yas la rus sbal g.yon: zhing lpags gsol te chu srin zhon: bstan pa srungs shig klu rgyal tshogs: zhes dam rdzas byin la phrin las bcol: gang 'dod las rnams byed par nges/ zhes so/ dregs pa rnams kyi spyi bor trig nan snying gar rang rang gi rnam shes la hur thuṃ dzaḥs bskor ba'i mthar so so'i ming gis bskor ba srog yig rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa la gzir 'phraug gcod pa'i mtshon chas bskul zhing*/ bdag gis sngags bzlas pas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/

dregs pa rnams kyi srog la phog pas bskul te rang dbang med par phan gnod kyi las gang bcol ma thogs myur du byed par gyur par bsam/ ming nas 'bod dam/ ming srog sbrags gam/ srog dmar 'byin gang 'os la/ skabs thob phan gnod gzir phrog gcod sogs sham bsgyur dang bcas pa gzhung bzhin bzla'o/ gzhung gi phan gnod kyi mdos zor dang*/ bsad gso/ dbab bcad/ srung zlog /bsad mnan/ sreg 'phang sogs las rab 'byams gang gsungs pa skabs su gang bab thams cad mtshams 'dir bya ba yin no: de nas dam nyams rang gshed rang la dbab pa drag po'i las la bskul ba ni: srin po ral pa bsnyegs pa grib so rab ruub bam: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams nam gyi 'jings la sha khrag dmar gtor byin la 'di skad drag tu bskul lo: dza bhyo ya: chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: bcom ldan dregs bdag stobs ldan nag po bhyo: dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad do: zhabs brgyad dregs pa'i snying khar rab tu gzir: g.yas kyi phyag dgus gser gyi rdo rje 'phen: snang srid dregs pa ma lus gzir bar byed: g.yon dgu bhan dmar dregs pa'i snying khrag 'thung : sde brgyad mgo bcad thod pa'i se ral brgyan: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas brgyad sku la gsol: klu chen brgyad kyis sku la rab tu brgyan: dpa' ba sgeg pa 'jigs su rung ba dang : bzhad dang gshe dang rab tu rngam pa'i gsung: zhi ba dul ba snying rjer ldan pa'o: 'bar ba'i gar dgur ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal gyi sku la gnyis med lhan sbyor yum: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'byung ba lnga'i bdag mo: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum tshul: yab yum thabs shes gnyis med phyag 'tshal bstod: spyi gtsug mkha' lding mgrin par rta mchog dpal: thugs kar rdo rje gzhon nu sked par phyag rdor 'phro: gsang gnas gshin rje'i gshed pos brgyan pa ni: thams cad 'bar ba'i gar dgur ldan zhing dregs pa sgrol:

sku ni sha za dregs 'joms gdug pa 'dul bar byed: gsung ni drag sngags 'od zer tsha tsha phyogs bcur 'phro: thugs ni skye 'gag med de 'khor 'das nyams thag gcod: khams gsum srid gsum thams cad dbang du sdud: dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i phrin las mdzod: dam can las la dgyes pa'-i phrin las mdzod: dgra bgegs zil gnon sgrol ba'i dus la bab: bhyoḥ rnal 'byor bdag la bka' srung ra mdar sdongs: gshin rje ma mo la sogs pa: lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dregs pa spyi yi sde dpon bhyo: badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ e yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: snying po sku gsung thugs las ma 'da' zhig: gal te dam las khyod 'das na: gzir bar byed pa'i yi ge yis: lus kyi dbang po gzir bar mchi'o: 'phrog par byed pa'i yi ge yis: snying dkyil rnam shes 'phrog par byed: gsod par byed pa'i mtshon cha yis: rang srog rang gis gcod par mchi'o: me chu tsha grang sdug bsngal 'byung : de bas dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: dza bhyo ya: bcom ldan thugs rje'i rol pa las: bcom ldan sku yi rol pa byung : bcom ldan sku yi rol pa las: bcom ldan gsung gi nga ro byung: bcom ldan gsung gi nga ro las: yi ge 'bar ba dzaḥru byung : dzaḥlas stong gsum pho nyar 'gyed: steng phyogs yi ge'i 'phro 'du las: zhe sdang yi ge ya ru byung : ya las yab gcig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khyod kyi thugs ni zhe sdang me ltar 'bar: zhe sdang dbang gis dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: 'og phyogs yi ge'i 'phro 'du las: 'dod chags yi ge ma ru byung : ma las 'byung lnga'i bdag mo byung : khyod kyi thugs ni 'dod chags chu ltar 'brub: 'dod chags dbang gis snang srid dbang du bsdus: 'dod chags zhe sdang gnyis med las: ma ning yi ge e ru byung : e las bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs rnams byung : khyod rnams sngags kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro:

rgyal ba'i bka' byung bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya: dza bhyoḥ ya ma ya yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: gshin rje yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ ma ma ru lu ma yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: ma mo yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: skye 'gro srog gi bdag mo dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ de wa ya yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: lha rnams yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: lha chen ma hā de wa dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ tirta ka tha yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: mu stegs yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: mu stegs kā lā yaksha dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ du phrag du yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: bdud po yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: bdud po me yi kha rlangs dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ duntiṃ du yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: bdud mo yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: bdud mo nag mo khrag 'dzag dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ raksha ra yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: srin po yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: srin po raksha glog phreng dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ rakmo ra yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: srin mo yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ raksha ra yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: gza' rnams yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: gza' bdud rā hu la yang dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ yaksha kṣa yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: gnod sbyin yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ yakmo kṣa yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: gnod sbyin mo yi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: gnod sbyin mo sha za ral can dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ rā tsa tsa yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: rgyal po yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: rgyal po le byin har legs dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ mun mun pa yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: dmu rnams yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo:

dmu rje btsan po dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ shū la tsa yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: btsan rnams yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: btsan rgod yam shud dmar po dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ badzra sā dhu tri yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: the'u rang yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ haṃ shaṃ tri yis thugs nas bskul tsa na: 'gong po yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: 'gong po khu le lag dgu dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ ru tri tri yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: dam sri yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: dam sri rkang lag ring mo dgra la bhyo: bhyoḥ sa nā ga phu yis gnad nas bskul tsa na: klu rnams yongs kyi sde dpon dgra la bhyo: klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po dgra la bhyo: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: legs nyes dpang po khyod kyis mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag gis ma len ma nyes ma yo'o: sngags 'chang bdag dang 'gras pa'i dgra bo 'di: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po 'di yis bshig: dkon mchog dbu 'phang 'di yis smad: bka' srung dam can khyod la 'gran gyi do btsugs so: ming dang bcas pa'i dgra bo 'di: lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par: zhag dang za mar khug la shog: sha khrag mchod pa dam pa bzhes: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: dza bhyo ya: bka' srung dregs pa bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas: thog mar byung yang bde gshegs bka' las byung : bar du gnas kyang bde gshegs bka' la gnas: tha mar byed kyang bde gshegs bka' las byed: de phyir bde gshegs bka' las ma 'da' bar: dam nyams rang gshed dbab pa'i dus la bab: dang po ye shes lha yi bka': bar du rig 'dzin rnams kyi bka': bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i las rnams ma lus gyis: dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya: gal te dam las khyod 'das na: rang lus rang gis gzir bar byed: rang khrag rang 'thung rang sha za:

rang srog rang gis gcod par byed: de bas rang srog srung zhing dgra bgegs sgrol: zhes khros pas drag tu bskul zhing*/ gtor ma byin la phur thun la sogs rbod gtong gi las sbyar ro: zhes pa ni rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i rgyud kyi le'u nyer bzhi pa'i lha bskyed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bstod bskul sogs rgyun du dgos pa rnams ngag 'don bsgrigs chags su bkol nas bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
